commit_message: Complete ADR0154 lint contract and authoring tests
pr_title: Implement ADR 0154 target-aware animation motion binding
pr_body:
Completes the ADR 0154 first-release contract audit on the current implementation: fixes a shared-planner Clippy warning, documents the schema-v3 candidate-only and motion-only Humanoid provenance contract in the canonical AI authoring specification, marks ADR 0154 Accepted and adds it to the decision map, and adds synthetic tests for transient Target Preview persistence/routing plus stable non-ambiguous VMD Humanoid provenance. Existing runtime, Problems, import-owned portable motion, packaging, and schema-v3 changes remain unchanged.

The PR remains Draft and must not be merged automatically.
